_comment: Class-tuning passes applied to the current season, newest first.
The dashboard's 'Since latest tuning' filter compares each run's exact start
instant (epoch ms, UTC) against the cutoff for the region whose realm the run
was played on, so a run counts only once tuning was live for it. Add a new
entry at the TOP after each pass - the dashboard and the LLM export always
use patches[0], and both hide the filter while this list is empty.
'regions' maps a WCL region code to the ISO8601 UTC instant tuning went live
there; 'default' covers every region not listed.
Emptied at the Season 2 launch: the Aug 18 pass shipped with the season, so
every recorded run already postdates it and there is nothing to split on.
